things to check before sampling to make sure you have all bonuses

added a 'snapshotting checklist' in the next msg

**1) Talents** (skilling preset) ⭐ 
**2) Vman** (preset with right hand, bonus stats + statues) <:vman:1109311077084303471>   
**3) Equipment** (skill eff equipment, wings, keychains, rings, trophy, necklace, hat) 👕 <:Wings:952726624342786079> 💍 🔑  <:idleskilling:802268150347071540> 💐 🎅 
**4) Alchemy** (equip large bubble) ⚗️

**7) Lab Nodes, Jewels, Chips** (skill eff, skill afk gains, doublers) 💎 
**8) Prayers** (dimwit, zerg, royal sampler) 💀 
**9) Star Signs** 🔭 
**10) Food** (golden food, boost food) 🥜  
**11) Divinity** - can ignore this if you have <:DootEmoji:898112013753004082> pet - Snehebetau 🐍 (30% afk gains) <:divinity:1053991021475803237>, 🐐 on other chars for min maxing, 🧸 2nd div on elemental sorcerer
**12) snapshotting postage** (quick ref to alchemy before sampling) 📸 

**situational**
**13) Fishing only - twines, baits, spot** 🎣 
**14) Mining only - hp shrine** ❤️ 
**15) mining/chopping/catching - mats in storage** 🟩 
**16) Mining/Chopping - snapshotting hp/mana** (cards, stats% equipment, potions, star signs, obols) 📸 - change back to regular skilling setup after doing #12
**17) Primordial Shrine** (if below 150% afk gains) 🗼 

**last minute upgrades**
**18) Post Office** 📫 
**19) Alchemy**  ⚗️ 
**20) Stamps** 🖼️ 
**21) Meals** 🧑‍🍳 
**22) atom collider** ('He' atom) ⚛️ 
**23) divinity** 🪰 <:divinity:1053991021475803237>  (scaled eff)
**24) doing quests** 📔 

small note regarding #15 - be careful not to use said mats for last minute upgrades in alchemy and be careful not to convert them to atoms before sampling

not sure if I understood the question correctly 🤔 but.... 

the 9 goat setup is a bit more of a meme build
maximizing gains on one char while 'ignoring' the rest

personally I go for 4 goats (maestro + archers)
to max oak/copper samples as much as possible (they equip snake)

also - ppl try to sample before weekly reset - that way u change divs (save the unlink till the end of the week( for sampling
then after weekly reset u can change back to you usual setup

I hope this answers 1st question

as for hp/mp snapshotting
I listed the steps here (in the 2nd msg)
https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1084953188647583819/1084953232356429834

the main idea is that the bonus eff from mana/hp - from bubbles - is calculated after loading map (or after checking alchemy for w/e reason)

so if u make sure u have as much hp/mana as possible on map load
and then switch to skilling gear while ignoring hp/mana - u can retain the 'best' bonus u can from hp/mana while still getting all the regular bonuses for skilling
